content:
The latest macOS 26.7 beta version seems to have leaked a large amount of information about several upcoming Apple home products. These include an all-new HomePod mini, a security camera, a next-generation Siri Remote for the new Apple TV 4K, and the highly anticipated HomePad product.

After an in-depth study of the code, it also appears to provide many important clues about the appearance of the HomePad...

Filipe Espósito of Engadget found several indications that, although the HomePad will most likely run some version of tvOS, its operation may be more like a larger version of the Apple Watch.

The code also points to a rather interesting privacy feature: the HomePad will only display your personal information on widgets when it detects your iPhone is nearby.

We expect the HomePad to launch in two versions: one with a speaker base that may look similar to a HomePod, and another expected to be used for wall mounting.

In addition to the other Apple home products mentioned above, the code also mentions some unknown new devices. Personally, I really hope one of them is a smart doorbell. Which Apple home products are you most looking forward to? Feel free to share your thoughts in the comments section.
